tables.title: Milestones
tables.note: CPO switch players: NVIDIA, Broadcom, Marvell, Ranovus x MediaTek
rows: NVIDIA — announces Quantum-X / Spectrum-X CPO switch (MRM)
Marvell — acquires Celestial AI (CPO for XPUs)
OCI MSA established at OFC — CPO industry standard for scale-up networks (founders: AMD, Broadcom, NVIDIA, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI)
GlobalFoundries SCALE — industry's first OCI-MSA-capable optical module platform (NPO/CPO); 2 CPO design-win tape-outs at Malta NY
TSMC: CoPoS pilot line operating, production 'a couple of years later' (~2028); advanced packaging capacity very tight, OSAT partners enlisted

Teradyne Photon 100 — SiPho/CPO production test platform (lab-to-fab); CPO TEST TAM $300-700M BY 2028 (2027 nearer ~$200M, gated on scale-out CPO ramp success); lens applied post EIC-PIC bonding means key optical tests can't run at insertion 1 (Teradyne Q2 FY2026)
BESI — CPO orders placed alongside the AP7 hybrid-bonder program; BESI HB delivers the CPO contact process (BESI Q1 FY2026)
ASMPT — designed in with multiple key CPO players across all 4 bonding steps (FAU/EIC/microlens/engine-on-substrate); CPO equipment TAM "interesting from 2028" (ASMPT Q1 FY2026)
STM — silicon-photonics PIC100 enters HIGH-VOLUME production for hyperscaler optical interconnect, on 300mm (STM Q1 FY2026)

AXT — record InP revenue $30.7M (+2x QoQ) on 1.6T transceiver migration; LONG-TERM SUPPLY AGREEMENTS signed with Coherent and Lumentum; hyperscaler move to near-packaged and CO-PACKAGED OPTICS called a continuing driver of InP demand; capacity 2x in 2026 and 2x again 2027 (AXT Q2 FY2026)

Coherent — NO push-out of CPO demand, the opposite: demand INCREASED and customer requests PULLED IN. Texas ramping the ultra-high-power CW laser for CPO (incl. the NVIDIA partnership), revenue from the DECEMBER quarter. CPO+NPO+integrated optics = >$15bn incremental TAM; CONTENT PER SOCKET COMPARABLE for CPO vs NPO ('just a different attach point'). Engagement intensity up sharply over the last 3-6 months — almost every large strategic customer has a CPO and/or NPO project. New PhotonLink full-stack integrated-optics platform unveiled at ECOC (launch 09-21-2026), first revenue Dec quarter. CPO for SCALE-UP revenue starts 2H CY2027; 200G VCSEL targeted at NPO (Coherent Q4 FY2026)

Astera Labs — optical in 3 phases: fiber-attached (aiXscale, 50m) VOLUME production 2027 at a tier-1 AI platform provider; NPO chipsets 2027; CPO-integrated Scorpio X switches 2028+ (Tbps optical I/O per switch); 'tens of billions' TAM beyond copper; in-rack scale-up stays copper this gen + next (Astera Labs Q2 FY2026)

Corning fiber-content framework — full-optical scale-up = 160 FIBERS/GPU (14.4Tbps/200G x2 + 16 scale-out) = 10x today's scale-out-only 16; Vera Rubin Ultra NVL576 = HYBRID (copper in-rack, optical rack-to-rack); >130k-GPU clusters need a 3rd optical layer (+50% content); content/GPU +1.3-1.5x by 2028; new PHOTONICS map (inside-the-box passives incl FAU) targets $10B by 2030 (Corning Q2 FY2026)

FormFactor - CPO test revenue ACCELERATING AHEAD OF PLAN: 2026 guide raised from $10-20M to 'significantly exceed $20M', with >$20M already expected by end-Q3; systems segment a record $48.5M (+74% QoQ) largely on CPO. Leadership in INSERTION 1 (known-good-die on the PIC wafer before it is combined with the EIC to form the optical module for scale-up/scale-out switches); served market ~$400M by 2030; revenue recognized through the leading foundry (11% customer) (FormFactor Q2 FY2026)
Credo closes Dust Photonics (SiPho PICs, 800G/1.6T -> 3.2T+, fewer lasers); CPO/NPO initial revenue expected FY2028
Veeco — >$250M multi-product orders (MOCVD/wet/IBD) for INDIUM PHOSPHIDE laser manufacturing; deliveries 2026, accelerating 2027 (copper->optics transition) (Veeco Q1 FY2026)
Semtech — 1.6T transceiver design wins at major module makers, shipments launch Q2-26; 800G LPO deployed at several hyperscalers (Semtech Q1 FY2027)
Keysight — 1.6T physical-layer test with 20+ industry leaders at OFC; first public Ultra Ethernet Consortium interop demo with Broadcom; 3.2T R&D rising (Keysight Q2 FY2026)
BESI/ASMPT view — next-gen GPU (2028) 3D stacking forecast to be HYBRID BONDED; CPO equipment TAM inflects (orders 2026, install 2027)
